title: dnd-5e-2024 species stats (docs/rulesets.md#species)
description: A page type: its traits are components it lists in order. Stored inputs only; derives `sizes` for the facet. Cross-field rules are checks in checks.ts (docs/rulesets.md#consistency-checks).

creatureType.description: The creature type. Every SRD species is Humanoid.

sizes.description: One or two sizes, each with its height as printed: "Medium (about 5–7 feet tall)".

height.description: Printed in parentheses after the size: "about 5–7 feet tall".

traits.description: Its special traits, in printed order.

intro.description: The sentence that opens the traits, where the SRD words it otherwise than the template's "As a Dragonborn, you have these special traits."
